hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Review combined reward balances across partner programmes and evaluate straightforward transfer options without technical jargon.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer has accumulated points across three separate partner programmes and needs a single consolidated view.
hypotheses.storyTension: Complex technical terminology and fragmented programme balances make it difficult to evaluate transfer options effectively.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Provide a clean, plain-English summary of all reward holdings alongside transparent, easy-to-understand portability options.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Clear, unified view of multi-partner rewards and portability options without technical jargon.

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Check current progress toward the Family Holiday Fund goal and review linked reward contributions.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer is actively working toward a specific savings and reward goal (Family Holiday Fund).
hypotheses.storyTension: Unclear alignment between multi-partner balances and ongoing progress toward the target goal.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Display transparent goal progress with jargon-free milestone breakdowns linked directly to available rewards.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Seamless progress tracking toward the Family Holiday Fund goal.
